author: Tarkeshwar Narayan Sharma
name: 10L/512d LeakyReLU² + int6 QAT + EMA + Sliding Window
blurb: 10-layer dim=512 with 2x MLP and LeakyReLU² activation. int6 QAT (start at 15%) + int8 embeddings, LZMA-compressed. EMA(0.9995) of weights for export. Sliding-window eval (seq_len=1024, stride=256). SP-1024 tokenizer, 10-min 8xH100 training.
